name: Dark Valley
desc1: This is large crack in the rock, most likely caused by an earthquake
desc2: long ago. The reddish stone walls rise up into the darkness, and are
desc3: covered in protruding black roots and glittering crystals. The floor
desc4: of the valley widens greatly here, as the walls grow farther apart.
desc5: Off to the east, something large looms in the darkness.
